mapper.insert: insert into book_notice (user_id, title, content, type, read_flag, biz_id, del_flag, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, '0', #{bizId}, '0', now())
mapper.select: select * from book_notice where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc limit 100
select count(1) from book_notice where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update book_notice set read_flag = '1' where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update book_notice set read_flag = '1' where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from book_notice where user_id = #{userId} and type = #{type} and biz_id = #{bizId} and del_flag = '0'

select b.id as biz_id, rd.user_id as reader_user_id, i.book_name, b.due_time from book_borrow b join book_reader rd on b.reader_id = rd.id join book_info i on b.book_id = i.id where b.status = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and rd.del_flag = '0' and b.due_time is not null and b.due_time between now() and date_add(now(), interval #{days} day)

select b.id as biz_id, rd.user_id as reader_user_id, i.book_name, b.due_time from book_borrow b join book_reader rd on b.reader_id = rd.id join book_info i on b.book_id = i.id where b.status = '2' and b.del_flag = '0' and rd.del_flag = '0'
